name: Adalo
description_en:
Adalo provides a visual app editor built around screens, components, database collections and actions. It is relevant when a team wants to assemble an app interface and its data interactions together, then evaluate web or native publishing options.

Its operational boundaries matter as much as the canvas: database permissions govern delivered data, custom actions can be shared across a team, and design-version restoration excludes database state. A credible pilot should test access and change recovery before relying on a polished preview.
description_zh:
Adalo 提供围绕屏幕、组件、数据库集合和动作组织的可视化应用编辑器，适合希望同时搭建界面与数据交互，再评估网页或原生发布方式的团队。

实际运行边界与画布同样重要：数据库权限控制数据是否下发，自定义动作可能由团队内多个应用共用，设计版本恢复则不包含数据库状态。试点应先验证访问权限和变更恢复，再判断预览效果是否足以投入使用。

core_features.explanation_en: A component can trigger a sequence of navigation, record and integration actions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 组件可以依次触发导航、记录操作和集成动作。

core_features.explanation_en: Collection rules restrict data access separately from component visibility.
core_features.explanation_zh: 集合规则独立于组件显示条件限制数据访问。

core_features.explanation_en: Saved designs restore visual configuration while leaving data and several app-wide settings outside the snapshot.
core_features.explanation_zh: 设计快照恢复视觉配置，数据及多项应用级设置不在恢复范围内。

en: Evaluate a member directory with relationship-based access.
Prototype a form-to-external-service flow with explicit output checks.
zh: 评估使用关系权限的会员目录。
制作表单与外部服务交互原型，并明确核对输出。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Create a small collection and connect a list and edit screen using synthetic records.
steps.zh: 用模拟记录建立小型集合，连接列表与编辑页面。

steps.en: Test two users, a denied request, and a shared-action change; document a separate data recovery method.
steps.zh: 测试两个用户、一次被拒请求和共享动作修改，并记录独立的数据恢复方法。

items.en: A design snapshot is not a database backup.
items.zh: 设计快照不能作为数据库备份。

items.en: Concurrent editor instances carry a documented overwrite risk.
items.zh: 同时打开多个编辑器实例有文档明确提示的覆盖风险。

pricing.summary_en: Free is listed at $0 with one editor and 500 records per app. Builder is advertised at $30 for the first month, then $65/month; Business is $200/month. Quarterly and annual offers have different totals. Publishing, editors and updates have plan limits; optional services can add charges.
pricing.summary_zh: Free 标价 $0，提供一位编辑者、每应用 500 条记录。Builder 首月促销 $30，之后每月 $65；Business 每月 $200。季付与年付另有总额，发布数量、编辑者及更新有方案限制，可选服务可能另收费。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_zh: 先定义记录模型再搭界面
sections.en: Collections hold records and typed properties; relationships connect records across collections. Map ownership and required relationships first, then connect screen components to that model. Treat a working list preview as evidence of rendering, not proof that every user has the right data access.
sections.zh: 集合保存记录及不同类型的属性，关系连接不同集合的记录。先明确归属和所需关系，再让屏幕组件绑定模型。列表预览正常只能说明显示成功，仍需单独检查各用户的数据访问。

sections.en: The Users collection supports property-specific view/edit rules; other collections use broader operation permissions. Some Logged In Users requires a relationship to Users and supports at most two relationship levels. Permission changes take effect without republishing, so test them as an immediate runtime change.
sections.zh: Users 集合可按属性控制查看和编辑，其他集合使用更粗粒度的操作权限。Some Logged In Users 需要关联到 Users，关系链最多两层。权限保存后无需重新发布即生效，应按即时运行变更测试。

sections.en: Custom actions call external services and expose Text, Number or Date/Time outputs. Screen-action outputs cannot feed subsequent actions, and custom actions cannot be attached directly to form submission. Team-level edits affect apps using that action; review consumers before changing a shared request.
sections.zh: 自定义动作调用外部服务，输出支持文本、数字或日期时间。屏幕动作的输出不能传给后续动作，也不能将自定义动作直接挂在表单提交上。团队级动作修改会影响使用它的应用，修改共享请求前需核对调用方。

sections.en: The introductory guide warns that multiple editor instances can overwrite changes. A plan offering several editors should therefore not be interpreted as proof of safe simultaneous editing. Assign ownership of an editing session and inspect the resulting app before handing it over.
sections.zh: 入门文档警告，多个编辑器实例可能互相覆盖改动。因此，方案提供多个编辑席位并不能证明可安全同时编辑。应明确每次编辑的负责人，交接前检查应用结果。

sections.title_en: Distinguish design recovery from data recovery
sections.title_zh: 区分设计恢复与数据恢复
sections.en: Design Versions supports up to ten saved versions on paid plans. Restoring one does not restore records, collection permissions, API keys, external collections, custom actions or publishing settings. Plan a separate data recovery procedure; a restored screen is insufficient evidence that an integration or permission change was undone.
sections.zh: 付费方案的 Design Versions 最多保存十个版本。恢复设计不会恢复记录、集合权限、API 密钥、外部集合、自定义动作或发布设置。数据需要单独的恢复方案，屏幕恢复不能证明集成或权限改动也已撤销。

sections.title_en: Check current plan names at purchase
sections.title_zh: 购买时核对当前方案名称
sections.en: The current pricing page uses Free, Builder and Business; some help pages still refer to Starter, Professional and Team. Use current offer details for purchasing and verify the entitlement needed for a particular publishing or custom-action workflow. A build artifact does not establish app-store approval.
sections.zh: 当前价格页使用 Free、Builder 和 Business，部分帮助页仍写 Starter、Professional、Team。购买时应依据当前报价，核对特定发布或自定义动作所需权益。生成构建产物不能证明已通过应用商店审核。
